basic_profile.bio: A tech enthusiast and part-time student based in the bustling city of Chicago. I'm an avid fan of historical dramas, particularly those with Viking themes. I spend my evenings and weekends exploring new supplements for health optimization and sharing my findings on Reddit. Currently single, I enjoy engaging with online communities to learn and share insights on my journey towards better health and wellness.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge of Norse mythology and Viking history is mostly self-taught through extensive reading and binge-watching series like 'Norsemen' and 'Vikings'. Additionally, I've been exploring the world of health supplements, driven by personal interest and online research.
